t: This is the Sainsbury's on Camden Road, and it's no ordinary supermarket. Completed in 1988, it was designed by Nicholas Grimshaw and Partners and stands on the site of the former Aerated Bread Company bakery in Camden Town. In 2019 it became the first purpose-built supermarket to be Grade II listed, for its futuristic architecture. Grimshaw, who died in 2025, was also behind Waterloo International station and the Eden Project, and won the RIBA Gold Medal.
